◈ Algorithmic Governance Policy

Under Fair Lending regulations, alternative credit scoring models must undergo routine fairness audits. Sensitive demographic traits (gender, geography, business category) are strictly excluded from model feature sets during training and inference. They are used exclusively by authorized auditors to compute post-hoc disparity metrics and verify non-discrimination.
